title: Wolves in the Forest
text:
Wolves are wild animals. They live in forests and cold places. Wolves live in packs. A pack can have six to ten wolves.

Wolves sleep in the day. At night, they hunt for food. They can run very fast. Wolves howl to talk to other wolves.

questions.text: When do wolves hunt for food?
Why do you think wolves live in packs?
options: They can hunt and stay safe together

questions.text: Why do you think wolves sleep during the day?
options: They are active at night and need rest
They are afraid of the dark
They cannot run during the day

vocabulary.definition: not tamed or kept by people
groups of animals that live and hunt together
chase and kill animals for food

paragraph_translations: Wilki to dzikie zwierzęta. Żyją w lasach i zimnych miejscach. Wilki żyją w watahach. Wataha może mieć od sześciu do dziesięciu wilków.
Wilki śpią w dzień. W nocy polują na jedzenie. Potrafią biegać bardzo szybko. Wilki wyją, aby rozmawiać z innymi wilkami.
